correctness.rationale: Explicit factorization of the affine 5x5 determinant into a pentagon triangle twice-area and opposite pentagon pair determinant establishes the four symbolic levels. Separately affine determinant expansion over arbitrary convex point representations proves the global upper bound, with an iff equality support rule. An exhaustive 252-subset integer-only combinatorial certificate proves three same-signed replacements per each of 50 maximizing vertex sets and forbids independent simultaneous replacements; hence exactly 75 one-coordinate segments and no other maxima. An independent floating 252-determinant and 50-sign crosscheck agrees; quoted body volume matches the primary theorem.
